usage: Pass colorway.refs paths as GenerateImage reference_image_paths. Merge promptLock into every generation prompt.

products.catalogRule: One product model, two colorways (not two separate SKUs).

promptLock.silhouette: Women's flat Mary Jane with soft square / rounded-square toe and single instep strap; chunky substantial Mary Jane proportions (not sleek almond ballet)
promptLock.upper: Ribbed knit fabric; strong vertical ribs on toe box; ribs follow contour / more horizontal around heel; heavier gauge than fine corduroy
promptLock.strap: CRITICAL: WIDE thick woven Mary Jane strap ~1.5–2+ cm across instep (NOT thin ribbon); denser honeycomb/seed-stitch/cross-hatch weave distinct from body ribs; visible padded thickness/depth; matching tonal matte plastic rounded-square buckle sized to strap width + silver prong
promptLock.vamp: Shallow center V-notch at throat opening (not deep U/oval scoop)
promptLock.heelCollar: Present smooth padded comfort pillow at heel — BLACK colorway = BLACK collar matching exterior (not tan); beige colorway = tonal tan/beige collar; substantial rolled cushion not thin binding
promptLock.heelWebbing: CRITICAL: centered vertical grosgrain/webbing reinforcement strip on exterior heel back (flush strip ~1.5–2 cm wide, NOT tall dangling pull-tab loop); visible on 3/4 and side rear
promptLock.heel: Very low flat integrated block heel (not tall sharp architectural)

branding.layout: Ornate crown above decorative crest; stacked serif MODEL / MATCH; small year banner (e.g. 1982)

sole.forefoot: Grid of small four-petal floral/clover grips (beige colorway) or checkered grid (black)

mustNot: X elastic cross straps
Ankle strap
Thin ribbon strap or dainty delicate strap
Missing heel vertical webbing strip
Almond/pointed tapered toe last
Deep U/oval throat opening
Blank insole when top-down / open view
Wrong brand name
